title: Shankarapali
description: Crispy, sweet diamond-cut pastry bites delicately sweetened with cardamom-infused powdered sugar and kneaded with fresh milk and ghee.

steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, blend maida and cardamom powdered sugar thoroughly.
Heat ghee until hot and pour over the flour. Rub well between your palms so the fat incorporates evenly.
Add warm milk 1 tablespoon at a time to form a firm yet smooth dough (slightly softer than chapati dough).
Cover with a clean cloth and rest for 15 minutes.
Roll the dough to approximately 1/2 cm thickness and cut into small diamonds using a pizza wheel or knife.
Deep-fry on medium-low flame until light golden brown. Drain and let cool completely to crisp up.

storyOrOrigin: A classic festive jar-snack prepared during Deepavali that stays crisp and melt-in-the-mouth for weeks.
grandmasSecrets: Fry on medium-low heat; they will continue to crisp up as they cool on the wire rack.
